Adele: Quick follow-up from the 2:10pm outage — it’s customer-impacting, affects the routing layer, and we need a PIR. Who can facilitate and take notes?
IncidentBot: Incident #INC-2026-042 closed at 14:58 UTC. PIR required by policy (>=30m customer impact). Use #incidents for coordination.
Priya: I can facilitate if no one else wants it. Available tomorrow 09:00-11:00 PT or 16:00-18:00 PT. happy to own the doc.
Marcus: I’m fine being backup. Can do tomorrow afternoon PT (after 15:30).
Erin: Product wants to join to confirm customer impact and follow-up comms. Prefer 10:00-11:00 PT.
Sam: I’ll do scribe if Priya facilitates. I have the logs and the repro notes already.
Jorge: Support wants to be there to speak to the three affected customers. I can forward CSM notes.
Adele: Thanks. Proposal: Priya facilitator, Sam scribe. Two tentative slots:
```
- Option A: 2026-03-16 16:00-17:00 PT (UTC-7) — Best for infra folks
- Option B: 2026-03-17 10:00-11:00 PT (UTC-7) — Best for product & support
```
Which one works for everyone? If both, prefer earlier.
Priya: Option A works for me. +1 to earlier.
Marcus: Option A ok but I might be 10min late.
Erin: Option A collides with another internal sync for me. Option B is better.
Lily: FYI on-call will be handing over at 17:30 PT tomorrow; I can join Option A until handoff, but Option B is cleaner for my schedule.
Priya: Hmm. Looks like mixed availability. Quick poll: who must attend (support, infra, product, on-call, exec)? If execs are needed we should do Option B morning.
Adele: Execs not required for this PIR. Required: infra (Marcus), on-call (Lily), support (Jorge), product (Erin), SRE lead (Priya), scribe (Sam). Optional: Zoe (engineering manager) for action sign-off.
Zoe: I can do Option A if it helps; my morning is flexible.
Jorge: If we do Option A I’ll ask CSMs to drop notes in the doc. They’re OK either day.
Erin: If Option A gets more infra attendance, I’ll make time. I’d rather not delay product follow-ups.
Priya: OK final call: Option A (2026-03-16 16:00 PT). I’ll facilitate; Sam scribe. Marcus and Lily acknowledged potential minor lateness. Adele, please send the calendar invite and include the PIR doc link.
Adele: Will do. Calendar invite created — Zoom link + PIR doc. Invite snippet:
```
Title: PIR - Routing outage - 2026-03-16
Time: 2026-03-16 16:00-17:00 PT
Attendees: Priya (facilitator), Sam (scribe), Marcus, Lily, Erin, Jorge, Zoe
Location: zoom.us/j/xxxxxxxx
Doc: https://redwood.docs/pir-routing-outage-2026-03-16
```
Priya: Thanks. Quick agenda:
1) Timeline & root cause hypotheses (5m)
2) Logs & repro (10m)
3) Customer impact summary (5m)
4) Action items and owners (20m)
5) Rollout / rollback learnings (10m)
Sam: I’ll pre-populate the doc with timeline + log excerpts and the repro steps.
Jorge: I’ll paste the CSM messages and quote customers for impact.
Marcus: I’ll bring the kernel/infra timeline and the deploy markers.
Lily: I’ll include the pager timeline and our mitigation steps.
Adele: Action items to create pre-meeting checklist:
- Priya: Facilitator, draft agenda (in doc)
- Sam: Populate timeline/logs
- Jorge: CSM/customer notes
- Marcus: Infra timeline/markers
- Lily: Pager handoff notes
I’ll tag owners in the doc and add a pre-read section.
Priya: Also want a small pre-read to save time: short TL;DR + one paragraph per owner listing what data they’ll bring. Can folks add that by EOD today?
Sam: I can add the TL;DR and timeline by 18:00 PT.
Marcus: I’ll add infra markers by 17:30 PT.
Jorge: CSM notes by 17:00 PT.
Erin: Product impact summary by 17:00 PT.
Lily: Pager handoff notes by 17:15 PT.
Adele: Great. One more: if anyone wants to swap facilitator role before the meeting ping me. If Priya needs to hand off, Marcus is backup.
Priya: All good for now. See you all in the doc. :thumbsup:
